FR-01.before:
Native American Graves Protection and Repatriation Review Committee; Notice of Public Meeting
AGENCY: National Park Service, Interior.
ACTION: Meeting notice.
SUMMARY: The National Park Service is hereby giving notice that the Native American Graves Protection and Repatriation Review Committee (Committee) will hold a virtual meeting, in accordance with the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended.
DATES: The Committee will meet via video conference on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. until approximately 6:00 p.m. (Eastern). All meetings are open to the public. The agenda and materials for this meeting will be posted on or before September 15, 2026 (see ADDRESSES).
ADDRESSES: Information on joining the meeting by internet or telephone as well as the agenda and meeting materials will be available on the National NAGPRA Program website at https://www.nps.gov/orgs/1335/events.htm.
FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Melanie O'Brien, Designated Federal Officer, National Native American Graves Protection and Repatriation Act Program (2253), National Park Service, telephone (202) 354-2201.
The agenda for the meeting may include a report from the National NAGPRA Program; the discussion of the Review Committee Report to Congress; subcommittee reports and discussion. Detailed minutes of the meeting will be available for public inspection within 90 days of the meeting.
FR-01.after:
Heritage Review Council — Notice of Public Meeting
The Riverton Heritage Office gives notice that the Heritage Review Council will hold an online meeting. All meetings are open to the public.
Date: Wednesday, October 14, from 2:00 p.m. until approximately 6:00 p.m.

Minutes: Detailed minutes will be available for public inspection within 90 days of the meeting.
Contact: Dana Vasquez, Meeting Officer, telephone (02) 354-2201.

ESTAT-01.before:
In 2024, 65% of the EU population aged 15 or over took part in tourism for personal purposes, in other words they made at least one tourism trip for personal purposes with at least one overnight stay during the year (such as holidays, leisure, visiting friends and relatives). However, large differences can be observed between the EU countries, as this participation rate ranged from 27.7% in Romania to 83.6% in the Netherlands (see Figure 1 and Table 1).
EU residents (aged 15 and above) made 1.2 billion tourism trips in 2024, either for personal or business purposes. Residents of Luxembourg, Belgium, Malta, Slovenia, Austria, the Netherlands and Cyprus made more foreign than domestic trips. The number of trips increased by 4% compared with 2023 and by 67% compared with 2020. Compared with the pre-pandemic year 2019, tourism by Europeans has fully recovered, with the number of trips being 5% higher in 2024. More than half (56%) of these trips were short trips of 1 to 3 nights (see Table 1). Around 71% of all trips made were to domestic destinations, while 29% were to destinations abroad.
ESTAT-01.after:
The above graph shows the share of people aged 15 or over who took at least one personal trip with an overnight stay in 2024, in the member countries of the Union.
Across the Union as a whole, 65% of this age group made such a trip. The rate differed widely between countries: it was lowest in Eastvale, at 27.7%, and highest in Norland, at 83.6%. Taken together, residents made 1.2 billion trips that year, 4% more than in 2023 and 5% more than in 2019, the last year before the pandemic. More than half of those trips, 56%, were short ones of one to three nights. Around 71% of all trips stayed inside the traveller's own country, while 29% crossed a border.

GOVUK-01.before:
Almost 3 million Child Trust Fund accounts held by 18 to 24 year-olds have either been claimed or transferred into an Individual Savings Account, HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) reveals as it encourages the thousands who don't know where their savings are to find them today.
Latest figures show around 827,000 young adults have a matured Child Trust Fund account waiting to be claimed, which could be worth on average 2,310 pounds.
Child Trust Funds are long term, tax-free savings accounts set up for children born between 1 September 2002 and 2 January 2011 with an initial government deposit of at least 250 pounds.
Young people can take control of their account at 16 and when the account matures at 18, can decide what they want to do with it - withdraw it to spend, leave it where it is or re-invest it.
If young people, or their parents or guardians, know who their Child Trust Fund provider is, they can contact them directly. If not, they can locate it via the online Child Trust Fund locator tool. Almost 500,000 young people used the GOV.UK locator tool to find their Child Trust Fund in the nine months to August this year.
It takes about 5 minutes to submit a request to find a Child Trust Fund through the online tool using the young person's National Insurance number and date of birth and, for most, less than 3 weeks to hear back.
The savings accounts are not held by government but are held in banks, building societies or other saving providers.
GOVUK-01.after:
Almost 3 million Youth Savings Fund accounts held by 18 to 24 year-olds have either been claimed or moved into an ordinary savings account, the National Revenue Office said this week, as it urged young adults who do not know where their savings are to look for them.
Around 827,000 young adults still have a matured account waiting to be claimed, worth on average 2,310 dollars. The accounts are long-term, tax-free savings accounts opened for children born between September 2002 and January 2011, each with a government deposit of at least 250 dollars.
Holders can take control of an account at 16. When it matures at 18, they may withdraw the money, leave it where it is, or re-invest it. Those who know their provider can contact it directly; the rest can use the Revenue Office's free online locator. Almost 500,000 young people did so in the nine months to August. A request takes about five minutes to submit and, for most, less than three weeks to answer.

verdict.question: 결손 1위 칸(B 무리 · 수요 21.1% · 상업 가능 재고 11편)을 실제로 채울 수 있는가
detail: 안내문 일치 · 글의 목적 · 내용 일치(글) · 도표 넷은 R0·R1 원천으로 채울 수 있다. 심경·분위기는 이 표본에서 R0·R1 원천을 하나도 못 찾았다.
공급량의 하한선은 측정된 값만으로도 재고 11편을 세 자릿수 배로 넘는다 — Federal Register 회의 공고 206편/90일 · gov.uk 보도자료 840편/90일 · gov.uk 안내 25,283편(전체) · NPS 요금 페이지는 표준 틀(표본 16/16).
다만 「원문 확보」는 R0·R1 만이다. 표본 20편 중 R0 10편 · R1 6편 = 16편이 원문 확보 경로이고, R2 1편(Wikivoyage) · R3 2편(World Bank 블로그 · Parks Canada) · G0 탈락 1편(climate.gov)이다.
가공 비용은 「경」이 0건이다. 목표 어수(91~136)가 원천(175~8,366어)보다 훨씬 짧아 삭제율이 55~75% 다. 값싼 슬롯은 아니지만, 가공 자체는 3/3 성공했다.
blockers: 심경·분위기(수요 3.5%) — 기관 발행 PD/CC-BY 원천은 인물의 내면을 쓰지 않는다. 이 표본 안에서 후보는 Wikivoyage 「Understand」 절뿐이고 그건 R2(재저작)다.
「얼마·언제」가 <table> 안에 갇힌 요금 안내가 있다(PC-01 은 가격이 평문에 0건, NPS-01 은 일부). 안내문 유형을 쓰려면 표 추출기가 먼저 필요하다.
climate.gov 는 목적 적합도가 높은데 라이선스 조문을 읽을 수 없어 탈락했다(noaa.gov disclaimer HTTP 403).
next_if_approved: Federal Register 회의 공고 → 안내문 일치. API 가 구조화돼 있어 DATES/ADDRESSES/CONTACT 를 필드로 뽑을 수 있다. 날짜·기관명은 G2 에서 가상화한다(지난 행사 64.3%).
gov.uk press_release → 내용 일치(글)·글의 목적. OGL v3 표기 문구를 정해 두어야 한다.
Eurostat Statistics Explained + OWID → 도표. 두 곳 다 「EU 외 데이터」·「제3자 데이터」 제외 조항이 있으니 기사 단위로 확인한다.
NPS 요금·시간 페이지 → 안내문 일치. 표 추출을 먼저 만든다.
심경·분위기는 이 축에서 풀리지 않는다 — C 무리(서사) 파일럿과 합쳐서 따로 본다.

limits: 표본 20편은 무작위가 아니다. 목록 상위·유명 공원·「가장 많이 본 기사」에서 골랐다 — 각 원천의 평균 품질이 아니라 **좋은 쪽**을 봤을 가능성이 크다.
본문 추출기는 이 파일럿용으로 새로 쓴 것이라 저장소의 `source-doc-inspect.mts` 정제(STRIP·DROP_SENTENCE)를 거치지 않았다. NPS 는 .gov 배너·스킵링크 약 130어가 본문에 섞여 있어 어수와 고유명사 밀도가 실제보다 높다 [측정: docs/NPS-01.txt 머리].
<table> 을 통째로 버렸다. 요금·시간표가 표에 있는 원천(PC-01 전부 · NPS 일부 · ESTAT 의 Table n)은 핵심 수치가 빠진 상태로 측정됐다.
「날짜가 지난 행사 안내의 비율」은 Federal Register 한 곳에서만, 그것도 제목·초록으로 날짜를 읽을 수 있었던 42/206 건에 대해서만 쟀다. 나머지 164건은 판정 불가다. 다른 원천(NPS·gov.uk)에 대해서는 못 쟀다.
G2 가공은 3편이다. 수정량 45.6~69.2% 라는 폭은 3개 표본의 것이지 원천 일반의 것이 아니다.
심경·분위기 유형의 후보였던 Global Voices 를 받지 못했다(연결 타임아웃). 이 유형에 대한 판정은 **못 한 것**이지 「불가」로 잰 것이 아니다.
Library of Congress · Smithsonian · NPS Data API 는 403 이라 안을 못 봤다. UA 사칭으로 우회하지 않았다.
법률 판단은 하지 않았다. 각 원천의 조문 원문과 URL 을 적어 두었을 뿐이다 — 특히 CDC 가 명시한 「미국 밖에서는 타국 저작권법이 적용될 수 있다」와 Eurostat 의 제외 조항은 사용자 판단 대상이다.
DB 를 읽지도 쓰지도 않았다. 재고 11편·수요 21.1% 는 demand-model.md 에 적힌 값을 그대로 인용한 것이다.
